summary: This function encodes the request body for a multipart/form-data request. It encodes files when passed as a dict or a list of tuples. The tuples may be 2-tuples (filename, fileobj), 3-tuples (filename, fileobj, contenttype), or 4-tuples (filename, fileobj, contenttype, custom_headers). The function supports encoding files, and it also supports encoding files with explicit filenames.
impact_factors: how often it changes or breaks
